$comment: Hand-written hints for story flags, used instead of what the tracker works out from game data (add one where that is missing or unclear). Keyed by flag ID. Write hints in your own words (don't copy wiki text) and name where the information came from. Contributions welcome.

jade_ironbar2.Text: Complete Jade's quest "Iron Bar for Jade"

DuskspireDefeated.Text: Defeat the Duskspire Behemoth at the bottom of the Deep Dark (Sword & Sorcery's final encounter)

Dale_DinnerDate.Text: Not available yet: East Scarp doesn't set this, and Dale's dating content is planned for a later update

Corwin_dateInvite.Text: May not be available yet: East Scarp doesn't set this flag, so this date can't start in the current version

willyBackRoomInvitation.Text: Finish the Community Center (or Joja's development projects), then Willy invites you to his back room

ccDoorUnlock.Text: Meet Mayor Lewis at the old Community Center, from Spring 5 of year 1 (or become a Joja member)

clothFound.Text: Get your first Cloth (it counts from the next day)

CF_Sewer.Text: Buy the Stardrop from Krobus in the Sewers

pamHouseUpgrade.Text: Buy the community upgrade for Pam's house from Robin and wait for it to finish

ccPantry.Text: Complete the Pantry bundles in the Community Center

ccCraftsRoom.Text: Complete the Crafts Room bundles in the Community Center

ccFishTank.Text: Complete the Fish Tank bundles in the Community Center

ccBoilerRoom.Text: Complete the Boiler Room bundles in the Community Center

ccVault.Text: Complete the Vault bundles in the Community Center

ccBulletin.Text: Complete the Bulletin Board bundles in the Community Center

slimeHutchBuilt.Text: Build a Slime Hutch on your farm

hasPickedUpMagicInk.Text: Pick up the Magic Ink in the Witch's Hut (the Wizard's 'Goblin Problem' quest)

ccMovieTheater.Text: Get the Movie Theater built in Pelican Town

HasDwarvishTranslationGuide.Text: Get the Dwarvish Translation Guide by donating all four Dwarf Scrolls to the museum

Island_Resort.Text: Rebuild the Ginger Island resort (give the parrot on the island's south beach 20 golden walnuts)

GiEXbundle.farming.done.Text: Complete the Farming bundle on Ginger Island

GiEXbundle.cooking.done.Text: Complete the Cooking bundle on Ginger Island

GiEXbundle.fishing.done.Text: Complete the Fishing bundle on Ginger Island

GiEXbundle.mining.done.Text: Complete the Mining bundle on Ginger Island

GiEXbundle.combat.done.Text: Complete the Combat bundle on Ginger Island

DitR_CT_GardenCompleted.Text: the second part of Sen's 6-heart event (Lurking in the Dark adds it once Sen's garden is finished)

cc_Bus.Text: the bus is repaired (Community Center Vault)

cc_Greenhouse.Text: the greenhouse is restored (Community Center Pantry)

Custom_Highlands.Text: Complete Marlon's special order "Marlon's Boat" (deliver 100 Void Essence), then take his boat from the Adventurer's Summit
